title: Bit encoding of a cell
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let a cell value contain an optional head descriptor and, for each tape, an optional Boolean symbol and a Boolean marker. For each natural number $t$, define its encoded bit as follows: if $t<h$, it records whether the head descriptor's index is $t$; otherwise, for tape index $i= rac{t-h}{3}$ when $i<k$, the remainder of $t-h$ upon division by $3$ selects, respectively, whether that tape's symbol is present, its symbol with absence interpreted as false, or its marker. If the resulting tape index is at least $k$, the bit is true.
hypotheses_covered: A cell value of the specified type
